cause_quote: The original Doctor migration used `if (runtime && runtime !== "openclaw" && runtime !== "auto")` and then `continue;`, skipping explicitly selected Codex jobs before checking whether they used a stored host account.
user_saw: Even after repeated runs of `openclaw doctor --fix`, the migrated Codex automation failed with “Automation has no recorded inference account.”
summary: Doctor now uses the Codex auth planner to record eligible host-managed accounts and their runtime while preserving inherited models and fallbacks.
reasoning: The path history and introducing diff show that Doctor's account migration skipped explicit Codex runtimes from its first version, even though the auth planner already supported forwarding stored profiles to Codex. The later #185070 diff rewrote the refusal message and kept the existing scheduled-account check.
